title: What is real, mocked, and deferred
purpose: Make the demo contract explicit before showing it.
takeaway: The core extraction, frozen scoring, validation, and OpenAI rewrite path are real; several quality grades and production capabilities remain mocked or deferred.

bullets: Real: retained-source parsing, P1 scoring, multi-query drafting, validation, review, and export.
Mocked: query alignment and answer clarity grades; the structural grade counts headings.
Deferred: persistent runs, live URL fetching, source-style rendering, HTML patching, calibrated graders, and GEPA.

speaker_notes: Say this before the demo so the audience knows what evidence each screen represents.
